sentence_stem: Although the film received mixed reviews,
correct_completion: it became a surprise box-office hit.
full_sentence: Although the film received mixed reviews, it became a surprise box-office hit.
acceptable_variants: it still earned a profit at the box office.

options.text: so the producers cancelled its release.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but the stem sets up a contrast with 'although', so this creates an illogical cause-effect link.

options.text: because the critics loved every scene.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause rather than a contrast, and the clause contradicts the 'mixed reviews' already stated in the stem.

options.text: it became a surprise box-office hit.
the budget was reduced last year.
options.why_wrong: This gives unrelated background information and does not complete the contrast expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Turkish speakers may be tempted to use a simple cause connector here because Turkish often signals contrast through suffixes and context, so in English the contrast must be made explicit with a separate concessive connector.
translation: Eleştirmenlerden karışık yorumlar almasına rağmen, film beklenmedik bir gişe başarısı haline geldi.
